Class CustomStack

java.lang.Object
dev.lone.itemsadder.api.CustomStack
Direct Known Subclasses:
CustomBlock, CustomFire, CustomFurniture
public class CustomStack extends Object
Wrapper for an ItemsAdder custom item stack.
